notes: The dative πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις is split: the quantifier stands bare and the noun carries the case preposition to discontinuously, following rules 21, 26 and 96 rather than bundling to all men into one unit.
ἐκδιωξάντων keeps out inside its own unit under rule 106, no Greek preposition being expressed for the particle to answer to.
s001 τῶν takes who under rule 90: the head noun it stands in apposition to (Ἰουδαίων) is in the previous verse, and rule 18 makes this verse the whole unit of work.
